m.aarti.tek: Victory to you, Mother Santoṣī; victory to you, Mother Santoṣī. You give happiness and wealth to your servants.
m.aarti.pad1: The Mother has put on a beautiful golden garment; diamonds and emeralds sparkle, and she has adorned her body.
m.aarti.pad2: The ochre-red lustre, the beauty and the lotus face shine; smiling gently, the compassionate Mother charms the hearts of the three worlds.
m.aarti.pad3: The Mother sits on a golden throne, and lovely chowries are waved; incense, lamps, naivedya, honey and dried fruits are set before her, a rare offering.
m.aarti.pad4: Jaggery and gram are most dear to you, and in them you found contentment; you came to be called Santoṣī and gave splendour to your devotees.
m.aarti.pad5: You hold Friday dear, and today is that very day. A gathering of devotion fills the place, spellbound as it hears the sacred story.
m.aarti.pad6: The temple glitters with light, and auspicious sounds fill it; we, your children, bow our heads at your feet and pray.
m.aarti.pad7: Accept this worship, full of devotion and feeling; whatever wish dwells in our hearts, grant its fruit.
